input.question: Who is the director of the film "Turkey Shoot"?

documents.text: Turkey Shoot (2014 film) Turkey Shoot (also known as Elimination Game) is a 2014 Australian dystopian futurist exploitation film directed by Jon Hewitt and co-written by Hewitt and his wife Belinda McClory. Shot in Australia, the film stars Dominic Purcell, Viva Bianca, Robert Taylor and Belinda McClory. Inspired by Brian Trenchard-Smith's 1982 "Turkey Shoot", the film features appearances by that film's Carmen Duncan, Roger Ward and the voice of producer Antony I.
